services.desc: Reserve an inflatable SUP rental that is simple to transport, easy to use, and ready for your next adventure. Fun, stable, and easy to use. Great for families and first timers. Kid, teen, and adult boards available. All rentals come fully equipped with paddle, leash, pump, fin, backpack, and PFD. Our most stable board ever. The X10 MAX gives you the freedom to sit or stand, plus the space to bring gear, a cooler, or even your dog. Comes with paddle, leash, pump, life jacket, backpack, 3-piece paddle, and seat. Our inflatable paddle board rentals are available only at our Union Square location in Sandy,
